name: Dual Grid Isosurface Extraction
definition: A method to extract crack-free isosurfaces from AMR data by treating cell centers as vertices of a new grid, avoiding dangling nodes caused by resampling to vertex-centered formats.
summary: Dual Grid Isosurface Extraction extracts crack-free isosurfaces from AMR data by using a dual grid to avoid dangling nodes, ensuring seamless connectivity without patching cracks.
